doc.title: Bill Watrous interviewed by Monk Rowe, Clinton, New York, March 26, 1999

title: Multiphonics and singing through the horn
summary: A short exchange on playing and singing to get a third note, to be demonstrated at his clinic.

story.theme_name: The reed and horn player's craft: clarinet, sax, tone
story.community_name: Lips, teeth and breath: the physical craft of brass playing

blocks.x: I’ve heard you doing some singing.
Is it possible to get a third note?
Yeah you get a third note.
You actually get an overtone on it. You play one and sing one and you get an overtone. Maybe I’ll demonstrate that in my clinic tomorrow as a matter of fact. © Fillius Jazz Archive -18-
And then next Monday all the kids in the trombone section will go [scats].
Oh yeah, they’ll get terrible sounds, they’ll be really bugging their band director.
